description: Branch session-end maintenance: revive memory + maybe generate an authored skill from real metrics.

steps.description: Clean agent MEMORY.md files, promote real facts, write memory_summary.md

steps.command: node -e "import('./dist/memory/session-metrics-tracker.js').then(m => { const env = m.currentSessionMetricsEnv(); process.env.SESSION_METRICS = env; return import('./dist/skills/session-skill-generator.js'); }).then(sg => { const metrics = JSON.parse(process.env.SESSION_METRICS || '{}'); if ((!metrics.toolCalls && !metrics.errorsRecovered && (!metrics.filesTouched || metrics.filesTouched.length === 0)) && m.loadSessionMetricsFromDisk) { Object.assign(metrics, m.loadSessionMetricsFromDisk()); } return sg.maybeGenerateFromSessionEnd(metrics); })"
steps.description: Load real SESSION_METRICS from the tracker (env first, disk fallback for the separate cron process), then distill a complex session into an authored- skill

notes: SESSION_METRICS is filled live by session-metrics-tracker via tool-hooks and memory-lifecycle-hooks. The cron step now falls back to reading .codebuddy/session-metrics.json from disk when the env is empty, because it runs in a separate Node process. Both steps are safe to re-run.
